svg.title: Agents Lifecycle
svg.desc: Context leads to Skills, Scheduling, Execution, Review and Artifacts. A request for changes or regeneration returns work to Execution, and the next revision returns for Review. Auditing is available from Review on demand after a change request. When enabled, feedback feeds Learning, which informs Skills for future runs. Notifications surface progress and requests for input or review. Stages depend on the agent, task and policies.

g.aria-label: Preparation, execution, review and reusable artifacts
Feedback informs future runs; auditing is optional
